thread:
carl-partnerships: quick sync request — can we lock down vendor windows for H100/H200/B200, MI300, and Gaudi? legal wants embargo windows + marketplace needs SKU tags by next Tue.

elena-ops: timeline's tight. power/thermal limits in us-west racks reduce H200 sloting. can we get vendor slot estimates? :thinking_face:

mike-hw: from infra side, H200 and H100 require different PSU profiles. H200 dense configs need 3.2kW per shelf in our staging racks. if marketplace wants GA in early sept, we have ~2 rack-weeks of prep.

rachel-systems: perf team flagged potential regression for Mi300 kernel 2.1.1 on our quantized path. request a hardware sample for run-it-overnight tests. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

nvidia-bob: NVIDIA update — H200 partner allocation limited in Q3, suggested customer-facing embargo lift target 2026-09-15. we can try to reserve a small runway for Redwood Dedicated pilot (2 nodes) to validate perf.

amd-ana: AMD update — MI300 driver stack .2.4 passed internal QA; we can support earlier marketplace tagging (2026-08-25) but need a signed compatibility addendum for our logos.

si_partner_jen: SI side — integration teams need a two-week lab window for H100->B200 fallback tests and orchestration for onramp. If embargo slides, that eats our bench time.

embargo-bot: [policy] Reminder: any public comms mentioning vendor model names require legal-embargo signoff tag `EMB-REQ-2026` before publishing.

carl-partnerships: thanks. action items I'm capturing: 1) mike-hw to confirm available rack-weeks and estimated provisioning lead time (by EOD tomorrow). 2) nvidia-bob and amd-ana to confirm embargo lift dates and any embargoed PR materials we must hold. 3) rachel-systems to run Mi300 kernel regression overnight and post results. 4) si_partner_jen to outline the minimum lab window and critical test cases.

mike-hw: can do. rough numbers: H100 pilot 4 RU, H200 pilot 12 RU, B200 can piggyback on H100 shelves. provisioning lead time: 7–10 business days for image/firmware bake.

rachel-systems: starting regression runs tonight. will paste a short log here when done.

nvidia-bob: confirmed embargo lift tentative 2026-09-15; will DM formal embargo doc and PR assets.

amd-ana: we'll send compatibility addendum to carl by tomorrow AM.

si_partner_jen: lab window request: 2026-08-10 -> 2026-08-24 (2 weeks). test list: live traffic replay, autoscaling under batch spikes, KV cache warmup.

carl-partnerships: perfect. one extra ask — marketplace tagging needs SKU mapping. mike, rachel, can you agree on a minimal SKU matrix we can hand to marketplace ops? e.g. `redwood-h100-v1`, `redwood-h200-dense-v1`, `redwood-mi300-q2`, `redwood-gaudi-econ-v1`.

mike-hw: i'll draft table. quick note: power profile for H200-dense must include `Pmax=3.2kW` and a thermal de-rate flag.

rachel-systems: patch log after runs:
```
[Mi300-run-01] quant-path throughput: baseline 160 tok/s -> current 145 tok/s (regression -9%).
Next steps: try kernel 2.1.0 fallback, then full quantization sweep.
```

carl-partnerships: thanks all. i'll consolidate as a short bulletin and tag legal + marketplace ops (cc @marketplace-ops). goal: finalized SKU map + embargo docs by Fri EOD so we can plan press/partner outreach the week after. :thumbsup:

amd-ana: ack.

nvidia-bob: ack, will push the embargo doc this afternoon.

si_partner_jen: will queue bench time once you share the exact shelf allocations.

em-bot: deployment note: attached `vendor-timeline-v3.md` to the /partnerships drive (link).
